style: flat cel-shaded game illustration, crisp dark contour, night freight yard, amber and cyan signal glow
notes: One art style for the whole project, repeated word for word at the head of every prompt (rule F.1c). Every mechanical sprite declares its orientation in words (rule C.8); the symmetric ones say so explicitly so nothing gets mirrored by accident - only sprite_station_marker is asymmetric, and the code mirrors it deliberately for the left verge. Sprites are drawn on whatever backdrop the model likes because the pipeline cuts the background away (rule F.1b), so no prompt argues about background colour. sprite_slot_frame and sprite_plate_panel are 9-sliced in their .meta, so their prompts ask for a flat hollow centre and a uniform border that survives stretching. sprite_rail_tile is stacked vertically, so its prompt describes its top and bottom EDGES rather than its geometry (rule F.1d). The four crate colours each carry a different white stamp shape, so a crate is readable on a compressed screenshot even without colour. No prompt contains the app name, and no sprite carries lettering of any kind (hard rule 1).
